summary: Tested Food Analysis bug fix and Food Browser sidebar feature. All 11 backend tests passed. Frontend Food Browser sidebar works correctly with 17,709 foods categorized. Food analysis for Lasagne, Chicken Tikka Masala, Banana, and Salmon all return correct nutritional data (not zeros).

food_analysis_lasagne.details: Lasagne analysis returns 418 kcal, 31.5g protein, 23.3g carbs, 21.1g fat. Shows 6 ingredients with DB matches (lasagna sheets→noodles, ground beef→beef, tomato sauce→tomato). Health score: 70 (Good)

food_analysis_chicken_tikka_masala.details: Chicken Tikka Masala returns 637 kcal, 50g protein, 11.3g carbs, 43.2g fat. Shows 9 ingredients with DB matches. Health score: 60 (Moderate)

food_analysis_banana.details: Banana returns 105 kcal, 1.3g protein, 422mg potassium. Correctly identified as fruit with medical considerations

food_analysis_salmon.details: Salmon returns 208 kcal, 20g protein, 2260mg omega-3. Correctly identified with allergen (fish) and medical considerations

food_browser_api.details: GET /api/food/browse-all returns 17,709 foods categorized into 13 categories with correct icons and counts

food_browser_sidebar.details: Browse Foods button opens sidebar showing Food Database with 17,709 items. Categories visible: Meats (3637), Fruits (2677), Other (2082), Dairy (2073), Vegetables (1674), Grains (1579), Beverages (939), Seafood (921), Legumes (867), Condiments (537), Snacks (497), Dishes (205), Supplements (21)

food_browser_category_expansion.details: Categories can be expanded to show food items. Clicking a food triggers analysis and closes the sidebar

food_browser_search.details: Search filters foods correctly. Searching 'apple' shows 572 matching foods

food_browser_click_to_analyze.details: Clicking a food in the Food Browser triggers analysis, closes sidebar, and displays results

context_for_next_testing_agent: Food Analysis and Food Browser features are fully functional. The smart_ingredient_search function with INGREDIENT_ALIASES map correctly matches recipe ingredients to database foods. The /api/food/browse-all endpoint returns all 17,709 foods categorized. Frontend Food Browser sidebar works on desktop (lg:flex) with category expansion, search, and click-to-analyze functionality.
